title: Performance Analysis and Scientific Mapping on Innovative Behavior Studies: A Bibliometric Research
content: This article presents a panoramic view of the scientific production on innovative behavior at a global level, which allows us to show authors and journals that are referents in the subject from 1961 to 2023, contributing to the Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 9. Methodologically, traditional bibliometric laws and computational tools (VOSviewer software) were applied for data processing. The results show an exponential increase in publications from 1990 to 2022 with a critical mass in innovative behavior studies, concentrated in 17 journals and 46 authors with 4 or more publications. The main organizations leading scientific production in this area are in China and Australia. Finally, the Web of Science categories where the main journals are concentrated are Business, Management and Psychology.
